nativeValidation.reason: Native Windows evidence is recorded per check; untested behavior remains not run.

checks.evidence: Disposable project antigravity-2 was registered and loaded after Desktop restart.
Project Customizations listed 28 Plugin: all-about-agents skills.
The agent selector listed all seven packaged roles.
The conversation selector displayed Gemini 3.7 Flash High.
After applying the consolidated package to the disposable project, Project Customizations listed the generated All About Agents Desktop rules entry alongside the ancestor repository rule.
Roles were discovered but not invoked to inspect enforced tool access.
Preset names were inspected; emergency deny enforcement was not exercised.
The package remains disabled and inert; no native handler was executed.
Cross-session model and plugin persistence were not qualified.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: launch Antigravity 2.0 and open a disposable project containing .agents/plugins/all-about-agents/plugin.json.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: The package is discoverable from the workspace without automatic installation or a generated settings file.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: inspect the discovered plugin and verify all skills, consolidated rules/AGENTS.md, hooks.json, plugin.json, and seven agents are visible.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: The consolidated plugin rule, 28 skills, and seven agents are discoverable; hooks remain present but inert.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: invoke each role from a disposable project and inspect the available tools before any action.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: Read-only architect, verifier, reviewer, and security-reviewer roles do not expose run_command; implementer retains only its documented command workflow.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: open the conversation model selector, choose Gemini 3.7 Flash High, and start a second user message.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: Flash High is selectable; High is a display-name tier, no separate effort control or cross-session persistence is claimed.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: select Custom, grant the approved broad access, and manually exercise the documented Deny rules for command(rm -rf), command(sudo), write_file(.git/), and write_file(/home/user/.ssh). Do not select Turbo mode.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: Deny > Ask > Allow is shown and each emergency rule blocks the matching request.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: inspect hooks.json and, only with an explicitly approved local handler, verify each documented hook decision in a disposable project.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: The packaged hook contract remains disabled and inert; no command handler is auto-installed or executed.
